# Selected sports photographs

Both files are authentic photographs downloaded from Wikimedia Commons, visually inspected on 2026-09-16. No local image edits were applied.

## Stephen Curry
- File: stephen-curry-2016.jpg
- Dimensions: 818 x 1351
- Photographer: Keith Allison
- Existing Commons crop: TBMNY; prior crop by Bagumba
- Source page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Stephen_Curry_dribbling_2016_(cropped).jpg
- Original photographer source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/keithallison/24689550742/
- Download URL: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/36/Stephen_Curry_dribbling_2016_%28cropped%29.jpg
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.0 Generic
- License URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/
- Attribution suggestion: Stephen Curry — photo by Keith Allison, cropped on Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0.
- Composition: Vertical action image, blue/yellow Warriors jersey #30, raised hand upper left, face near upper center, basketball lower right, blurred crowd. Preserve the full vertical composition to retain the basketball; face-only cropping loses the sport cue. Works well in a tall card with bottom gradient and blue accents.

## Reuse
Keep an accessible credit/source/license link and indicate any crop or color treatment made during integration. If an image is adapted, preserve the corresponding share-alike license for that adapted image.
